**Ordering / dependencies (the substantive triage finding):**
1. #2048's object model first (in progress) — every importer maps *into* it.
2. #5839 (content model cluster: blocks vs pages vs daily notes) and #5844 (attachments & media cluster) next — #5848's own scope names attachments-intact round-trip as an acceptance property, and Joplin's note/resource/tag model maps onto the content model's answers.

A shared importer contract should be settled once — with the first importer design (any of #5845–#5848) — rather than four times: source-model mapping shape, idempotency/re-import behaviour, link rewriting, and the round-trip test-corpus format are identical questions for all four. #5848 (Joplin) is a good second or third importer, not the template: its resource/attachment handling is the most idiosyncratic of the set.
4. Only then #5848's Joplin-specific design: Joplin's note/tag/resource model → #2048 objects, round-trip export expectations, and its test corpus instance of the shared format.

**Blockers recorded:** sequencing only — #2048 (active, not blocked), #5839, and #5844 are open design work ahead of this ticket. No Drew decision is needed. Issue #5848 stays open as the design ticket (programme epic #2056); implementation timing is a separate decision per the filing note.
